title: Fairy Tail Officially Returns With New Revival From Original Creator After 9 Years
content: Fairy Tail has returned with a brand new revival series from the original creator behind it all nearly ten years after the manga came to its end. title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Releases Song from 'A(E)liens'
content: The official X/Twitter account for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) announced on Wednesday that it has digitally released a song from the "A(E)liens" story "Pavilion" by Nanahira with composition and arrangment by Tsumiki .

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Now Streaming on Crunchyroll, Blu-ray Released in Japan
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – Infinity Castle Arc Chapter 1: Akaza Return (Movie 1) is now officially streaming on Crunchyroll. This coincides with the film’s Blu-ray and DVD release , which was scheduled for July 29 in Japan. The film began streaming on at 8:00 a.m.

title: 9 R.I.P. sequel Visual Novel's Trailer Reveals October 27 Release in West
content: Idea Factory International began streaming on Tuesday a promotional trailer for the supernatural visual novel 9 R.I.P. sequel , and it reveals that the game will launch physically and digitally in the West for Nintendo Switch on October 27.

title: An Official One Piece/Spongebob SquarePants Crossover Has Been Announced
content: Anime crossovers are nothing new for the medium, with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates having plenty of anime crossovers of their own. In one instance, the Straw Hats teamed up with Dragon Ball’s Z-Fighters to tackle some wild challenges, though this next crossover is unlike anything we’ve seen before.
